Completed the review in [the alpha drift report](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-alpha-step1-drift.md). It contains 81 page sections, each with one verdict.

No ordering changes, new pairs, or rescoping.

`validate-plan` passed. It reported four redundant-prerequisite warnings on the Monotone and Sard pages. `drift-review-check --before-apply` held on 13 unresolved blockers requiring owner action: Pin/Spin, spin geometry, real Clifford KO/ABS, Hall stability, Brauer/BMW, Jones–Wenzl traces, TL towers, Beilinson–Bernstein localization, Poincaré representations, noninvertible symmetries, modular categories, higher categories, and Frobenius sewing. I did not create owner resolutions.

The report records source locators for the mathematical reviews, including the [Cartan–Dieudonné proof](https://www.math.toronto.edu/mein/teaching/LieClifford/cl12.pdf), [Brauer centralizer results](https://arxiv.org/abs/1207.5889), [Poincaré little-group analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-th/0611263), [ABS Clifford modules](https://www.math.ens.psl.eu/~benoist/refs/ABS.pdf), and [localization notes](https://yisun.io/notes/dmod.pdf).
